claim: Nationalmuseet adult admission is 150 DKK (135 DKK online), under-18 free, open daily 10:00-17:00.
quote: Adults: 150 DKK ... 135 DKK (10% discount when you buy your ticket online) ... Under 18 years old: Free ... Mon - Sun 10:00 - 17:00

claim: Nationalmuseet's standout treasures include the Trundholm Sun Chariot, Egtved Girl, Gundestrup Cauldron and the Gold Horns of Gallehus.
quote: The prehistoric Sun Chariot is the only object of its kind in the world ... Egtved Girl ... Gundestrup Cauldron ... Gold Horns of Gallehus

claim: Permanent exhibitions span Danish Prehistory, Middle Ages and Renaissance, Stories of Denmark 1660-2000, plus a dedicated Viking Sorceress display.
quote: Danish Prehistory (ground floor), Danish Middle Ages and Renaissance (first floor), and Stories of Denmark 1660–2000 (second floor) ... The Prophecy of the Viking Sorceress

claim: SMK adult admission is 130 DKK (95 DKK for ages 18-26), under-18 free, with Copenhagen Card holders free.
quote: Ages 0-17: Free ... Ages 18-26: DKK 95.00 ... Ages 27+: DKK 130.00 ... Visitors holding a Copenhagen Card receive free entry

claim: SMK is open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-18:00, with extended Wednesday hours until 20:00; closed Mondays.
quote: Tuesday–Sunday from 10:00–18:00, with Wednesday hours extending until 20:00, and it's closed Mondays

claim: SMK holds Denmark's largest art collection of 260,000+ works including Danish Golden Age masterpieces, European Old Masters, and works by Mantegna, Hammershøi, Munch, Matisse and Rubens.
quote: more than 260,000 works spanning over 700 years ... gems by artists such as Mantegna, Nolde, Anna Ancher, Derain, Rubens, Matisse, Hammershøi, Munch

claim: Glyptoteket is open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-17:00 (Thursdays until 21:00), with free admission on the last Wednesday of every month from January 2026.
quote: Tuesday-Wednesday, Friday-Saturday, Sunday: 10:00 AM–5:00 PM ... Thursday: 10:00 AM–9:00 PM ... From January 1, 2026 ... free admission to the museum

claim: Glyptoteket adult tickets are 125 DKK (95 DKK ages 18-26) with 10% online discount and free entry for under-18 and Copenhagen Card holders.
quote: Standard tickets cost 125 Danish kroner ... 95 kroner for visitors between 18 and 26 ... 10% off the admission price ... Children 17 and younger get in for free

claim: The Glyptotek houses over 10,000 works founded in 1888 by brewer Carl Jacobsen, with Northern Europe's largest collection of ancient Mediterranean art plus French Impressionist and Post-Impressionist paintings.
quote: founded in 1888 by brewer Carl Jacobsen ... over 10,000 works ... Egyptian, Greek, Etruscan and Roman art ... extensive collection of French impressionists and Post-impressionists

claim: The Glyptotek's centerpiece is a glass-domed Winter Garden conservatory with palm trees and a fountain featuring Kai Nielsen's Water Mother sculpture, making it an ideal rainy-day destination.
quote: Winter Garden, a glass-domed conservatory with mosaic floors, towering palm trees, and a central fountain featuring the sculpture The Water Mother by Kai Nielsen

claim: Designmuseum Danmark charges 140 DKK adult / 90 DKK student admission, open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-18:00 (Thursdays to 20:00).
quote: Adults: DKK 140 ... Students/under 27: DKK 90 ... Tuesday – Sunday: 10.00 – 18.00 ... extended Thursday hours until 20:00

claim: The Danish Chair: An International Affair is the museum's signature permanent installation, a 'chair tunnel' of 125 chairs by Wegner, Mogensen, Jacobsen and Panton including the Round, Ant, Series 7 and Panton chairs.
quote: Hans J. Wegner's Shell Chair (1963) and Valet chair (1953), and Arne Jacobsen's Ant Chair and steel-and-plywood Series 7 (1955) ... Wegner's 1949 Round chair ... Verner Panton's 1960 Panton chair

claim: ARKEN Museum of Contemporary Art is in Ishøj 20 km south of central Copenhagen, open Wednesday-Sunday 11:00-17:00 (Thursday to 21:00) with 140 DKK adult admission.
quote: Wednesday to Sunday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., except for Thursday when it stays open until 9 p.m. ... 140 Danish kroner

claim: ARKEN sits in a beached-ship-shaped building beside Ishøj beach and holds over 400 contemporary works by artists including Damien Hirst, Olafur Eliasson and Ai Weiwei, reached by S-train line E in about 30 minutes.
quote: marine-like structure resembles a beached ship ... over 400 works by influential contemporary artists like Damien Hirst, Olafur Eliasson, and Ai Weiwei ... 16 minutes (on S-train line E)

claim: ARKEN's 2026 program includes SUPERFLEX's Come Hell Or High Water (May 2026-Jan 2027), Thomas Dambo's The Garbage Man, and 55.6° North drawing from the permanent collection.
quote: Come Hell Or High Water (May 2026-Jan 2027): A SUPERFLEX exhibition ... The Garbage Man (May-Nov 2026): Thomas Dambo's artistic response ... 55.6° North (Feb-Aug 2026)

claim: Consensus rainy-day pick when time is short: the Glyptotek combines ancient sculpture, Impressionist paintings and a heated Winter Garden under one roof, a 'warm sanctuary from Danish weather'.
quote: wonderfully warm and inviting sanctuary, a perfect escape from the Danish weather ... a great museum for a rainy day

claim: Travelers split Glyptotek vs SMK by taste: SMK wins for late-19th/early-20th-century European painting and Danish Golden Age, Glyptotek for sculpture and antiquities.
quote: Then I would definitely choose Statens Museum for Kunst :) ... late 19th and early 20th-century European paintings over sculpture
